map.折现率变化对 LCOE 的敏感度分析。: Sensitivity analysis of LCOE to changes in the discount rate.
map.CAPEX 500 万元、20 年、折现率 6%、年运维 10 万元、年发电 1: CAPEX 5 million CNY, 20 years, discount rate 6%, annual O&M 100,000 CNY, annual generation 1.2 million kWh: CRF=0.06·1.06²⁰/(1.06²⁰−1)≈0.0872; LCOE=(500×0.0872+10)/120≈(43.6+10)/120≈0.447 CNY/kWh. Tip: when the discount rate rises by 2%, the LCOE increases notably.
map.LCOE 越低越好吗？: Is a lower LCOE always better?
map.在同等可靠与并网条件下，LCOE 越低竞争力越强；但需结合消纳、波动性与辅助成本: Under equivalent reliability and grid-connection conditions, the lower the LCOE the stronger the competitiveness; but it must be viewed together with curtailment, volatility and ancillary costs.
map.为什么折现率影响大？: Why does the discount rate have a large impact?
map.高折现率抬高远期发电现值权重低，CAPEX 回收压力大，LCOE 上升；政策利率: A high discount rate gives distant generation a lower present-value weight, increases the CAPEX recovery pressure and raises the LCOE; policy interest rates and risk premiums transmit directly.
